prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective walking through a dark, forested path under a starry night sky. The camera moves steadily forward, capturing the silhouettes of trees and bushes lining the narrow trail. As the person progresses, the camera angle remains at eye level, providing a continuous view of the path ahead, which is barely illuminated by the faint glow of the stars above. The surrounding environment is shrouded in darkness, with only the outlines of the trees and vegetation faintly visible against the night sky. The camera occasionally pans slightly to the left and right, revealing more of the dense forest on either side of the path. The starry sky is dotted with numerous bright points of light, creating a serene and tranquil atmosphere. The weather appears to be cloudy or foggy, adding a layer of mist that softens the visibility of distant objects. The entire scene is devoid of any other people, emphasizing the solitude and quietness of the nighttime walk in Le Prarion, Chamonix-Mont-Blanc, France. The camera's smooth movement and the consistent focus on the path create an immersive experience, drawing the viewer into the peaceful and isolated setting.
